headline: Nubank Temporarily Suspends Cryptocurrency Deposits and Withdrawals
summary: Digital bank Nubank temporarily suspended cryptocurrency deposit and withdrawal services, notifying customers via its application while working to restore functionality.
why: Service interruptions in crypto-asset operations can temporarily limit retail engagement and liquidity access across digital banking platforms.

impacts.name: Nubank
impacts.why: Technical suspensions in crypto features may affect short-term user transaction volumes.
